description: This file defines the ComplexTensor class for handling complex number tensors in PyTorch, including methods for creation, conversion, and dispatching, as well as the Complex autograd Function for forward and backward operations.

classes.name: ComplexTensor
classes.description: A subclass of Tensor that decomposes complex tensors into real and imaginary parts, supporting custom dispatch and tensor operations.

classes.name: Complex
classes.description: A custom autograd Function for creating ComplexTensor instances with forward and backward methods.

methods.name: from_interleaved
methods.description: Creates a ComplexTensor from an interleaved real and imaginary tensor.

methods.name: as_interleaved
methods.description: Returns the interleaved complex tensor representation.

methods.name: __tensor_unflatten__
methods.description: Reconstructs a ComplexTensor from flattened inner tensors.

methods.name: __tensor_flatten__
methods.description: Flattens the ComplexTensor into a list of inner tensors.

methods.name: __repr__
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ComplexTensor.

methods.name: is_pinned
methods.description: Checks if the tensor is pinned in memory.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Creates a ComplexTensor from real and imaginary tensors, used in autograd.

methods.name: backward
methods.description: Computes gradients for real and imaginary parts during backpropagation.
